scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --config third-party-notices.jsonc --modules node_modules/.cache/bundled-modules --check-assets build --title Copywraith --out build/Third-Party-Notices.txt
scripts.notices:rust: python3 scripts/rust-notices.py -p copywraith-tauri --title Copywraith --overrides licenses/rust-overrides.json --out node_modules/.cache/rust-notices.txt --rust-std build/Rust-Licenses.html
scripts.notices:app: node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --config third-party-notices.jsonc --modules node_modules/.cache/bundled-modules --check-assets build --title Copywraith --include node_modules/.cache/rust-notices.txt --out build/Third-Party-Notices.txt
scripts.notices:deb: RUST_DOC="$(rustc --print sysroot)/share/doc/rust" RUSTC_VERSION="$(rustc --version | cut -d' ' -f2)" python3 scripts/deb-copyright.py generate licenses/linux/copyright.json --copyright-out node_modules/.cache/copyright
